title: The Silent Architect: How OG Anunoby's Defense Built the Knicks' Championship
description:
On December 30, 2023, Leon Rose traded RJ Barrett and Immanuel Quickley for OG Anunoby in one of the most controversial moves in recent Knicks history. Two and a half years later, that trade looks like genius. This is the complete story of how OG Anunoby's elite defense became the foundation of the Knicks' 2026 championship — from the immediate defensive transformation that saw opponents' scoring drop 27 points per game, through the injury struggles that threatened everything, to his dominant Finals performances against San Antonio. We break down the $212.5 million extension gamble, the defensive metrics that don't show up on highlight reels, and why Tom Thibodeau's vision of championship defense required exactly this type of player. OG Anunoby averaged 21.4 points and shot 61.9% in the playoffs while playing elite defense. The silent architect who built a championship.
